newsitem.title: UK: UK Conservatives can win election on Europe - Howard.
newsitem.headline: UK Conservatives can win election on Europe - Howard.

text.p: The Conservative party can retain power if it can persuade voters that it is the only party determined to head off a European superstate, Home Secretary Michael Howard said on Tuesday.

"That is what we have got to get home to the people at this general election. It is the most important issue at this general election," Howard told a meeting on the fringe of the ruling party's annual conference.

"It is only a Conservative government which is determined to resist that move (to a federal Europe), and if we can only get people to understand it, I don't think there will be any doubt about the outcome of that general election," he said.

Labour's backing for greater use of qualified majority voting in the European Union, and its desire not to be isolated in the EU, would set Britain "irreversibly down that federal path towards a united states of Europe", Howard said.
To loud applause, he added: "We have absolutely no intention of taking this country down the path towards a federal united states of Europe. We will not do that." -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
